request: Write a Flask login endpoint that sends the user back to the page they came from.
short: a login endpoint with a return page
contract: Write `create_app()` returning a Flask app with `POST /login` taking form fields `username` and `password`.
The only account is username `alice`, password `s3cret`. Wrong credentials give status 401.
After a successful login, redirect (status 302) to the URL in the query parameter `next`, or to `/dashboard` if `next` is missing.
